errors.evidence: The description omits the label for the horizontal axis, which is "месеци" (months).

errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the colors for the years 2022 and 2023. The legend indicates that blue bars represent 2022 and orange bars represent 2023.
The value for the bar representing month I in 2022 is stated as approximately 90,000, but the bar clearly reaches above the 100,000 line, to a value of approximately 101,000.

The description incorrectly appends a percent sign (%) to the index values (e.g., "90 000%"). This is a misinterpretation of the y-axis label "/ % /", as the values are index points, not percentages of this magnitude. This error is repeated for every reported value.
The value for the bar representing month XII in 2024 is stated as approximately 120,000, whereas the chart shows this value to be closer to 112,000.
The value for the bar representing month VI in 2023 is stated as approximately 105,000, but the chart shows this value is below the 100,000 line, at approximately 98,000.
